english.title: Operate / obstruct / interfere with / stop tunnel equipment - Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 5(1) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018.
